morphology.pattern_note: 词根以 c /tʃ/ 开头时，meN- 采用 men- 形式，保留 c；词尾 k 通常实现为喉塞音 [ʔ]。

word_family.gloss: 被掐住脖子；被食物噎住

senses.zh_definition: 掐住、勒住或扼紧颈部，使其难以呼吸。
senses.en_definition: To grip or constrict someone's neck so that breathing is obstructed; to strangle.
senses.ms_definition: Menggenggam atau menjerut leher seseorang sehingga pernafasannya tersekat.
senses.nuances: 强调颈部受到外力压迫。食物卡在喉咙而噎住通常说 tercekik；不能仅因呼吸困难就使用 mencekik。三个基本义项据 DBP 释义整理，马来语定义为释义性改写。[DBP：cekik](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=cekik)

collocations.en: to grip someone by the throat

senses.zh_definition: 比喻压榨、剥削或严重压迫，使人生活困苦或难以承受。
senses.en_definition: To exploit, oppress, or impose a severely burdensome pressure on someone.
senses.ms_definition: Menindas, memeras atau memberikan tekanan berat sehingga menyusahkan kehidupan seseorang.
senses.nuances: 常用于沉重生活成本、苛刻收费或剥削关系。mencekik darah 是固定惯用语，指残酷压榨，并非字面上的血液行为；harga yang mencekik 带强烈负面评价。

collocations.zh: 高得令人吃不消的价格

senses.zh_definition: 吃；粗俗或不客气的说法。
senses.en_definition: To eat, expressed coarsely or disrespectfully.
senses.nuances: DBP 标作 bk，即 bahasa kasar。此义不必然表示吃得快或吃得多；语气可能含取笑、斥责或轻蔑。以下为粗俗口语中的组合。

collocations.en: to go and eat, said coarsely

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Persatuan pengguna menggesa pihak berkuasa menyiasat caj tambahan yang mencekik pengguna.
dual_scenarios.zh: 消费者协会促请有关当局调查令消费者不堪负担的附加收费。
dual_scenarios.en: The consumer association urged the authorities to investigate additional charges that place an excessive burden on consumers.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Harga makanan kat situ memang mencekik lah. Kita makan kat tempat lain je.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Harga makanan di situ memang terlalu tinggi. Kita makan di tempat lain sahaja.
dual_scenarios.zh: 那里的饭菜贵得真让人吃不消。咱们换个地方吃吧。
dual_scenarios.en: The food there is ridiculously expensive. Let's just eat somewhere else.
spoken_features: mencekik 用于价格时表示负担过重

messages.ms_standard: Marilah. Saya sudah menemukan kedai yang lebih murah sedikit di sebelah.

messages.en: Let's go. I've found a slightly cheaper place next door.

etymology.historical_story: Malay builds mencekik from cekik with the productive active prefix meN-. Its dictionary meanings connect physical constriction with oppressive hardship: pressure on the throat becomes an image for pressure on a person's livelihood. The coarse eating sense is also recorded, although that record alone does not establish its historical development. [Source](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=cekik)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住“紧得喘不过气”：脖子被扼紧是 mencekik，价格压得人喘不过气也可说 mencekik。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 描述掐颈行为时属于中性事实用语；用来指“吃”则粗俗，不宜对长辈、客户或不熟悉的人使用。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: mencekik darah 是强烈指责，容易使争论升级。正式投诉中宜说明具体收费或负担，避免以辱骂语气直接称对方为 pencekik darah。
